assumptions: All relevant unlisted Z2-even exchanged primaries have dimension at least 8.
All relevant unlisted Z2-odd exchanged primaries have dimension at least 7; NOT 8.
Retained CFT data lie within twice the quoted input errors, with shared low inputs varied coherently.
epsilon-prime is nondegenerate and the published sparse-bootstrap constraint on its epsilon-epsilon coupling applies; the rounded range is padded outward to [1.5349,1.5375].
Sampled nonlinear envelopes and finite numerical conformal-block/quadrature calculations cover the continuous-parameter corrections; no interval arithmetic was used.
Reflection positivity and crossing apply to the exact correlators.
important_corrections: arXiv:2602.04958 reports previously unlisted parity-even, Z2-odd spin-3 and spin-6 primaries below dimension 8; the old odd completeness-below-8 hypothesis is not retained.
The new central display is an interval midpoint; the retained-spectrum central calculation is unchanged.
No independent or Gaussian errors were assumed in the box-plus-crossing optimization.
